title: issue.update/v1 request
description: Legacy issue.update/v1 only when explicitly authorized; generic HTTP resources use http.write/v1 instead. Through change.propose/v1 use operation=update (or the exact legacy frozen intent operation), target.locator=the observed numeric issue ID as a string, precondition.revision=issue.read response issue.updated_at and its evidence_refs. Each change is SET /fields/<authorized-field-key> with the intended value; custom fields use /fields/custom_field.<numeric-id>. verification is READ_BACK over exactly those changed paths and may be omitted. Do not use raw Redmine request bodies, APPEND or comments. This effect does not grant additional issue or field access.
